title: C-4 — scheduler_{run_id}.jsonl (Aditya, B)
description:
Two record types, discriminated by `type`.

The `candidates` array is F-3 in full. It is what lets you compute routing-error rate post hoc — for each dispatch, whether an alternative node would have finished materially sooner — and, critically, whether the error came from a BAD POLICY or a STALE ESTIMATE. Without estimate_age_ms per candidate, H3 is unanalysable.

policy.description: F-1: all five selectable from a single config value, no code change between runs.

staleness_param_s.description: F-8. The s served by the StalenessVeil for this run.

tie_break_draw.description: From the injected rng. Policies hold no state of their own except this.

estimate_age_ms.description: Required by H3. Also drives the staleness ceiling above which a node is treated as unavailable (§12.4).

admissible.description: F-14: applied by the AdmissionFilter OUTSIDE the policy, so every policy inherits it identically.

observed_lag_ns.description: Residual staleness floor. Measure and report it as a floor on achievable estimate freshness (§2 note 1).
